title: Goal-Driven Autonomous Optical Experimentation via a Self-Recursive Hardware-Software Harness
title_zh: 基于自递归软硬件工具链的目标驱动自主光学实验

paragraphs.en: 提出目标驱动自递归光学框架，通过光谱反馈将目标色差从19.756降至1.211，验证了软硬件自我修订能力。 We propose goal-driven self-recursive optical research in which agents use physical evidence to revise the hardware, software, models, and protocols used to pursue a scientific goal. The framework can be instantiated with different stimulus systems and measurement devices. We formalize its updates and derive a relation between physical attainability, command access, and model approximation error. We demonstrate the concept in an optical see-through color-matching case study using an iPad, RayNeo X3 glasses, and a TOP 300 probe coupled to a CAS140D spectroradiometer, both from Instrument Systems. A revised glasses application adds USB-controlled RGB holds and frame acknowledgements, keeping model-generated colors displayed during spectral acquisition. The interface passes 12 live control checks. Spectral feedback reduces one target color difference from 19.756 to 1.211 ΔE_76^*; all five targets improve in a separate comparison. These measurements demonstrate the concept in one configuration. The resulting software and protocols remain available for subsequent investigations.
paragraphs.zh: 提出目标驱动自递归光学研究框架，智能体利用物理证据修订用于追求科学目标的硬件、软件、模型与协议，通过光谱反馈将目标色差从19.756降至1.211，验证了软硬件自我修订能力。 该框架可以用不同的刺激系统和测量设备进行实例化。 我们对其更新进行了形式化，并推导出物理可达性、指令可及性与模型近似误差之间的关系。 我们在一项光学透视颜色匹配案例研究中演示了这一概念，使用一台iPad、RayNeo X3眼镜，以及一台与CAS140D光谱辐射计相连的TOP 300探针，两者均来自Instrument Systems公司。 经过修订的眼镜应用程序增加了USB控制的RGB保持和帧确认功能，使模型生成的颜色在光谱采集期间持续显示。 该接口通过了12项实时控制检查。 光谱反馈将一个目标颜色差异从19.756降至1.211 ΔE_76^*；在另一项对比实验中，所有五个目标均有所改善。 这些测量结果在一种配置下演示了该概念。 所生成的软件与协议仍可供后续研究使用。
